name: Hexadecanedioic acid
description: Hexadecanedioic acid (CAS 505-54-4 ), also known as thapsic acid, is a long-chain dicarboxylic acid used as a functional building block across specialty chemical formulations. Its bifunctional acid structure makes it a reactive intermediate for polymer synthesis. This versatile chemical is essential for creating ester-based lubricants and advanced emulsifier systems. In lubricant and metalworking fluid formulations, it serves as a precursor to complex ester base fluids that deliver high-temperature stability. These fluids are valued for providing low-friction performance in demanding industrial environments. Personal care manufacturers incorporate it into wax esters and emollient systems where controlled spreading and surface modification are required. Food-grade ester derivatives produced from this acid are used as emulsifiers and release agents in processed food applications. In polymer chemistry, it functions as a diacid monomer for nylon and polyester synthesis. The material contributes to the development of high-performance materials with defined chain length and thermal properties. Hexadecanedioic acid is supplied as a white crystalline powder or flake for easy handling. Technical grade is the standard commercial form, with purity levels typically at 98% or higher. Food-grade and high-purity grades are available for applications requiring tighter specification compliance for global markets. This includes ester synthesis destined for food or cosmetic end use where purity is critical.
